conditions.text: Request and confirm access to confidential sales tables internal.sales.daily_by_product and internal.sales.products from Retail Operations (Marco Bianchi).

Reconstruct pre/post-2024-04-01 product code mapping from distinct product_code values in internal.sales.daily_by_product, document unmatched ambiguous names, and treat the 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10 till migration gap as missing data rather than zero sales.
Verify exact GPS coordinates of Valdena Gelato Shop for api.open_meteo_archive queries (replacing assumed Verona coordinates) and include CC BY 4.0 attribution.

agreements.reason: Agree with feasible_with_conditions: directly meets N1 daily grain across both windows once Retail Operations grants access, the 34-day till migration gap is treated as missing (not zero), and the 2024-04-01 product code cutover is mapped.
Agree with feasible: open internal table covering 2022-present with is_open and event_name flags, meeting N5 with no blockers.
Agree with feasible_with_conditions and dismissal of DQ-METADATA-CONTRADICTION: counties=null is expected for national Italian holidays, though regional Veneto holidays are absent.

overrides.reason: Clarification on coordinate assumption: Verona (45.44, 10.99) was used as a northern Italy proxy because Valdena is fictional; exact shop coordinates must be confirmed with the client before production modeling.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: If internal.sales.daily_by_product started after 2023-06-01 (rather than 2022-01-01) or if Retail Operations denies access or confirms that pre-2024-04-01 L-suffixed product codes cannot be reconciled with post-cutover codes, N1/N2 historical modeling would be blocked.
